# Mishra and Associates

> Mishra and Associates is a Delhi-based tax and compliance firm offering GST, income tax, TDS, audit, ROC and accounting services in India, and company registration in India, the USA, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong, China and the UK.

- Website: https://mishraandassociates.in
- Phone: +91 11 6926 6597
- Email: contact@mishraandassociates.in
- Location: Delhi, India (services delivered online across India and internationally)

## Practice areas
- [Company Registration — India & Global](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Company%20Registration): Incorporate in India, the USA, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong, China or the UK — entity selection, filings, banking support and FEMA/ODI compliance for Indian promoters.
- [GST Services](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=GST): Complete GST compliance — new registration, return filing, amendments, refunds and notices.
- [Income Tax Return (ITR)](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Income%20Tax): Accurate ITR filing for salaried individuals, businesses, professionals and NRIs, with tax planning.
- [TDS Services](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=TDS): Quarterly TDS / TCS returns, Form 16 generation, lower-deduction certificates and notice resolution.
- [Tax Litigation & Representation](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Litigation): Appeals, scrutiny assessments, demand notices and tax dispute resolution before authorities.
- [PF & ESIC](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=PF%20%2F%20ESIC): PF & ESIC registration, monthly challans, returns and employee compliance management.
- [Trademark & IP](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Trademark): Trademark registration, objection replies, copyright and design protection for your brand.
- [Business Registration (India)](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Incorporation): Pvt Ltd, LLP, OPC, Section 8, Partnership and Proprietorship — complete incorporation support in India.
- [MCA / ROC Compliance](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=ROC%20%2F%20MCA): Annual filings, board minutes, director changes and all MCA / ROC compliance for companies and LLPs.
- [Import Export (IEC)](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Import%20%2F%20Export): IEC registration, DGFT services, export documentation and foreign trade compliance.
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=Accounting): Monthly bookkeeping, financial statements, payroll and MIS reporting for businesses.
- [MSME / Udyam Registration](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=MSME): Udyam registration, updates and government scheme assistance for small businesses.
- [FSSAI Food Licensing](https://mishraandassociates.in/services?category=FSSAI): FSSAI basic, state and central food licence registration, renewal and modifications.

## Company registration by country
- [Company Registration in India](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/india): Private Limited, LLP or OPC — incorporated online through the MCA, with PAN, TAN and bank-ready documents.
- [Company Registration in the USA](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/usa): Delaware C-Corp or Wyoming/Delaware LLC — formed remotely, with EIN, registered agent and India-side ODI compliance.
- [Company Registration in the UAE](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/uae): Free Zone or Mainland — 100% foreign ownership, residence visas and a competitive corporate tax regime.
- [Company Registration in Singapore](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/singapore): Private Limited (Pte. Ltd.) with ACRA — fast incorporation, nominee director options and a respected tax regime.
- [Company Registration in Hong Kong](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/hong-kong): Private Company Limited by Shares — no local director needed, territorial tax system and access to Greater China.
- [Company Registration in China](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/china): Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) — full control of your China operations, from licence to bank account.
- [Company Registration in the UK](https://mishraandassociates.in/company-registration/uk): Private Limited Company with Companies House — quick online incorporation, no residency requirement.
